uca_sentences: A bald man wearing sunglasses hid something in his white short sleeves, then turned around and walked inside. The boss at the counter stood up and looked.
The boss at the counter stood and looked in the direction where the man in white short sleeves left.

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I saw a man who stole something turn around and hide something. I think he was wearing white short sleeves. A woman at the counter stood up and looked around.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man who stole something. He was wearing a black short-sleeved shirt and hid something in his pocket before turning around. A person who works in the shop looked at him, then stood and looked at him. I think this person might have stood up and was at the counter.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who stole something; his upper clothing was white short sleeves and he hid something before turning around. A person who works in the shop stood up, but I'm not sure if they were at the counter. Another man who was just nearby had a grey coat, but I'm not sure about his position.
